en: Black‑and‑white view of an industrial harbor. In the foreground a cargo boat is moored along the quay. Behind it stands a large steel harbor crane on tall lattice legs reaching over warehouse buildings. Coal or similar bulk material is piled in the background, and additional cranes are visible further away. On one of the central buildings the word "BUNKE" (likely part of a longer word such as 'BUNKER') is painted.
